obligations.name: Risk management system
obligations.summary: Establish, implement, document and maintain a continuous risk-management process across the AI system's lifecycle. Identify reasonably foreseeable risks, including those during human oversight, and adopt risk-mitigation measures.

obligations.name: Data and data governance
obligations.summary: Training, validation and testing data must meet quality criteria: relevant, representative, free of errors and complete. Bias examination, data-collection processes documented.

obligations.name: Technical documentation
obligations.summary: Maintain technical documentation demonstrating compliance: system architecture, data flows, performance metrics, validation runs, post-market monitoring plan.

obligations.name: Record-keeping (automatic logs)
obligations.summary: High-risk AI systems must automatically log events relevant to identifying risks and substantial modifications, retained for an appropriate period.

obligations.name: Transparency and information to deployers
obligations.summary: Provide instructions for use, capabilities/limitations, expected accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity properties so deployers can use the system as intended.

obligations.name: Human oversight
obligations.summary: Design measures so natural persons can effectively oversee operation, intervene, and override outputs (including stop / kill-switch capability).

obligations.name: Accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity
obligations.summary: Ensure appropriate accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity throughout lifecycle; resilient to errors, faults, inconsistencies, adversarial inputs, model evasion, and data poisoning.

obligations.name: Quality management system
obligations.summary: Providers must put in place a documented QMS covering compliance, design control, technical specifications, data-management procedures, and post-market monitoring.

obligations.name: Post-market monitoring
obligations.summary: Providers actively collect and review data on system performance throughout its lifetime, including continuous compliance with the requirements above.

obligations.name: Reporting of serious incidents
obligations.summary: Providers must notify market-surveillance authorities of serious incidents (including significant cybersecurity breaches) within prescribed timelines.
